LactationInfantContextOutput.description: Basic information about one baby and their relationship to the current delivery.

age_days.title: Age Days

age_months.description: Completed calendar months of age as of as_of_date, not days divided by 30. Prefer the mother’s actual delivery date; null when no usable date exists or it is in the future.
age_months.title: Age Months

birth_date.description: Actual birth date of the baby in YYYY-MM-DD format; null when unrecorded.

birth_order.description: Birth order starting at 1 for babies from the current delivery; null for other babies.

infant_id.description: Stable baby profile UUID; required to update this baby’s profile or the current_infants relationship.

is_current_delivery.title: Is Current Delivery

latest_measurement.description: Latest valid length, weight, or head circumference measurement; null when no valid growth record exists.

name.description: Name or nickname recorded in the baby profile.

birth_order.title: Birth Order

LactationMotherContextOutput.description: Compact maternal profile information relevant to the current milk supply assessment.

actual_delivery_date.description: Actual date of the current birth, formatted YYYY-MM-DD; null when unrecorded.

age.description: Mother’s current age in completed years; null when unknown or unrecorded. Not inferred from delivery date.
age.title: Age

current_delivery_method.description: Delivery method for the current birth: vaginal, cesarean, assisted_vaginal, other, or explicitly recorded as unknown; null when unrecorded.
current_delivery_method.title: Current Delivery Method

current_feeding_mode.description: Current feeding mode: exclusive_breastfeeding, expressed_milk_feeding, mixed_feeding, formula_feeding, or explicitly recorded as unknown; null when unrecorded.

postpartum_days.description: Completed calendar days since delivery as of as_of_date; day of delivery is 0. Derived from actual_delivery_date; null when missing or after as_of_date.

preferred_name.description: Mother’s preferred name; null when not recorded.
